pages.title: Ribosome Assembler
pages.text: A cell's protein factory, scaled up: it reads messages codon by codon and strings amino acids together.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the reading speed and the magnesium. Faster reading makes more mistakes per codon, and a protein of L codons comes out right with chance (1 − ε)^L; that must reach the recipe's yield. Magnesium away from 10 mM makes it sloppier.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Engineered Enzyme, Messenger RNA, Minimal Synthetic Cell.
